pub fn float_pow() {
    let mut criterion = Criterion::default().configure_from_args();

    powi_f32(&mut criterion);
    powi_f64(&mut criterion);

    #[cfg(all(f128_enabled, not(feature = "no-sys-f128")))]
    powi_f128(&mut criterion);
}
